message:
You know that one friend who always seems a bit too ready for anything? We all have that gloriously over-prepared person in our lives. Just the other day, while packing for a weekend trip, they pulled out their go-bag filled with snacks, first-aid supplies, and even a portable water filter. It made us chuckle, but then we started to think about how nice it would be to have such peace of mind. 

Maybe there’s something to be said for being just a touch over-prepared. It can turn a simple outing into an adventure, and who knows when those extra snacks might come in handy? What little things do you keep on hand for peace of mind?
